يتعاطى (form VI)
# يَتَعَاطَى (yataʕāṭā) /ja.ta.ʕaː.tˤaː/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative/subjunctive of تَعَاطَى (taʕāṭā)
# يُتَعَاطَى (yutaʕāṭā) /ju.ta.ʕaː.tˤaː/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative/subjunctive of تَعَاطَى (taʕāṭā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
